svg.title: Verification status
svg.desc: Eleven verified behaviours — the test suite, both MCP transports, live harness discovery, a real llama.cpp server, and encryption at rest — against seven unverified ones, including a live Hermes model session, the OMP compaction hook firing for real, and signed release artifacts.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A release claim is worth exactly as much as the evidence behind it.
